target.title: fix(codex): honor timeoutSeconds for dynamic tool calls
target.body:
Closes #98864

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex dynamic tool calls such as `sessions_send` could pass `timeoutSeconds` without `timeoutMs` and still hit the default OpenClaw dynamic-tool watchdog instead of the requested per-call seconds budget.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Codex app-server dynamic-tool timeout readers now treat `timeoutSeconds` as the seconds-form fallback after `timeoutMs`, including the side-thread dynamic-tool path. `timeoutMs` keeps precedence, invalid or non-positive seconds values still fall back to existing defaults, and the existing capped timeout handling path is unchanged.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented by Codex. No agent transcript is included because sanitized transcript insertion was not approved in this automated run.

## User Impact

Users and agents can use seconds-form dynamic-tool budgets for bounded helpers without being silently capped by the default 90 second dynamic-tool guard. This is especially relevant for session helper calls that expose `timeoutSeconds` to the model.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts` (passed: 2 files, 55 tests)
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` (clean: no accepted/actionable findings)
